name: Heart of Isha Awak
summary: Hunters seek Isha Awak’s heart along the Merchant Coast south of Ratchet. Mahren Skyseer wants it as proof that the Deep Doom has been overcome.

sections.title: Trophy of the Deep Doom
sections.body: Isha Awak prowls the sea off the Merchant Coast, south of Ratchet. Sailors and coastal folk revere and fear the massive thresher, known as the Deep Doom. It has killed many human trespassers along the shore. Mahren Skyseer, a tauren mystic, sees an honorable predator, not a mindless menace. She believes its fierce spirit dwells in its heart. Mahren charges brave hunters to plunge into the waves, defeat Isha Awak in its own domain, and claim the heart as both trophy and spiritual offering.

faq.q: What is the Heart of Isha Awak?
faq.answer: The Heart of Isha Awak is the heart of the giant thresher that prowls the waters south of Ratchet. Hunters claim it as proof of overcoming the Deep Doom for Mahren Skyseer.

faq.q: Who wants the Heart of Isha Awak?
aliases: who do i give the heart to
faq.answer: Mahren Skyseer, a tauren seer camped along the Merchant Coast south of Ratchet, wants hunters to retrieve the heart. She seeks to honor the beast’s power and absorb its spirit.
Isha Awak dwells in the ocean off the Merchant Coast in the eastern Barrens, south of Ratchet.

faq.q: Why does Mahren Skyseer want the heart?
aliases: why does mahren want the heart
faq.answer: Mahren Skyseer considers Isha Awak an honorable hunter and worthy adversary. By slaying the beast and holding its heart, a hunter takes the sea creature’s spirit into themselves.

angles.text: As a tauren hunter, you pursue Isha Awak as an act of spiritual communion with nature’s fiercest predators, guided by the elder Mahren Skyseer.
As a hunter, you face an ultimate test of courage when tracking and conquering the Deep Doom beneath the Merchant Coast’s waves.
